title: MQTT measurement sources
sourceHelp: Link one manual sensor to one exact topic, without wildcards. Start the server receiver to collect messages.
notConfigured: MQTT reception needs to be enabled and configured on the server.
payload: Publish a JSON object using a decimal string, the exact sensor unit (or null) and a timestamp with timezone. Retained messages keep their original observation time. Example:

errors.sourceHasMeasurements: This source has measurement history. Pause it to keep its history.
errors.conflict: This source changed. Reload before trying again.
errors.alreadyLinked: This sensor or topic already has a source.
errors.sensorUnavailable: This sensor is disabled or its device retired.
errors.instanceChanged: The configured broker changed. Restore its server configuration before resuming this source.
errors.invalidInput: Choose a sensor and an exact topic without spaces or wildcards.
errors.invalidSample: A message was rejected: check the value, unit and timestamp.
errors.sampleConflict: A different reading already exists at this observation time.
errors.failed: The MQTT message could not be processed.
errors.capacity: A maximum of 100 MQTT sources per broker is supported.
errors.refreshFailed: Saved, but the source list could not be refreshed. Reload the list without repeating the action.

validation.sensorInvalid: Choose an enabled sensor on available hardware.
validation.topicInvalid: Enter an exact topic of up to 200 characters without spaces, control characters, #, + or $.
